arxiv-2105-00528.title: A 1D-CNN Based Deep Learning Technique for Sleep Apnea Detection in IoT Sensors
arxiv-2105-00528.creator: Arlene John 1 , Barry Cardiff 2 ,Deepu John 2
arxiv-2105-00528.description: Abstract † † This work is supported by the Irish Research Council under the New Foundations Scheme. Internet of Things (IoT) enabled wearable sensors for health monitoring are widely used to reduce the cost of personal healthcare and improve quality of life.

arxiv-2302-13604.title: On n-Hausdorff homogeneous and n-Urysohn homogeneous spaces
arxiv-2302-13604.creator: M. Bonanzinga, N. Carlson, D. Giacopello, F. Maesano
arxiv-2302-13604.description: Abstract In this paper we study n n -Hausdorff homogeneous and n n -Urysohn homogeneous spaces. We give some upper bounds for the cardinality of these kind of spaces and give examples. Additionally we show that for every n > 2 n>2 , there is no n n -Hausdorff 2-homogeneous space.

arxiv-2309-08126.title: Analysis of a stochastic SIR model with media effects
arxiv-2309-08126.creator: Jiaxun Li, Yanni Xiao
arxiv-2309-08126.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate a stochastic SIR model with media effects. The uniqueness and the existence of a global positive solution are studied. The sufficient conditions of extinction and persistence of the disease are established. We obtain the basic reproduction number R 0 S R_{0}^{S} for stochastic system, which can act as the threshold given small environmental noise.

arxiv-2312-07372.title: Incoherent processes in dileptons production in proton-nucleus scattering at high energies
arxiv-2312-07372.creator: Sergei P. Maydanyuk 1,2, Gyorgy Wolf (1)
arxiv-2312-07372.description: Abstract Purpose: Incoherent processes in production of lepton pairs in the scattering of protons off nuclei are investigated. Methods: New quantum mechanical model is constructed which uses generalization of the nuclear model of emission of photons in the proton-nucleus reactions in region from low up to high energies with inclusion of formalism of production of lepton pairs.

arxiv-2403-04426.title: Spin-Phonon interaction in quasi 2D- C ​ r 2 ​ T ​ e 3 Cr_{2}Te_{3}
arxiv-2403-04426.creator: Gurupada Ghorai, Kalyan Ghosh, Abhilash Patra, Prasanjit Samal, Kartik Senapati, Pratap K. Sahoo
arxiv-2403-04426.description: Abstract Spin-phonon interaction plays an important role in 2D magnetic materials and motivates the development of next-generation spin- and charge-dependent microelectronic devices. Understanding the spin-phonon interaction by tuning the growth parameter of single crystal Cr T 2 ​ e 3 {}_{2}Te_{3} , a robust quasi-2D room temperature magnetic material, is crucial for spintronic devices.

arxiv-2403-09700.title: Shapley Values-Powered Framework for Fair Reward Split in Content Produced by GenAI
arxiv-2403-09700.creator: Alex Glinsky, Alexey Sokolsky
arxiv-2403-09700.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alex Glinsky, Alexey Sokolsky. It is evident that, currently, generative models are surpassed in quality by human professionals. However, with the advancements in Artificial Intelligence, this gap will narrow, leading to scenarios where individuals who have dedicated years of their lives to mastering a skill become obsolete due to their high costs, which are inherently linked to the time they require to complete a task—a task that AI could accomplish in minutes or seconds.

arxiv-2403-10751.title: LightCode : Light Analytical and Neural Codes for Channels with Feedback
arxiv-2403-10751.creator: Sravan Kumar Ankireddy, Krishna Narayanan, Hyeji Kim
arxiv-2403-10751.description: Abstract The design of reliable and efficient codes for channels with feedback remains a longstanding challenge in communication theory. While significant improvements have been achieved by leveraging deep learning techniques, neural codes often suffer from high computational costs, a lack of interpretability, and limited practicality in resource-constrained settings.

arxiv-2411-09389.title: Less is More: Unseen Domain Fake News Detection via Causal Propagation Substructures
arxiv-2411-09389.creator: Shuzhi Gong, Richard O. Sinnott, Jianzhong Qi, Cecile Paris
arxiv-2411-09389.description: Abstract The spread of fake news on social media poses significant threats to individuals and society. Text-based and graph-based models have been employed for fake news detection by analyzing news content and propagation networks, showing promising results in specific scenarios.

arxiv-2511-00505.title: Zero-RAG: Towards Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Zero Redundant Knowledge
arxiv-2511-00505.creator: Qi Luo, Xiaonan Li, Junqi Dai, Shuang Cheng, Yining Zheng, Xipeng Qiu, [4pt] School of Computer Science, Fudan University
arxiv-2511-00505.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation has shown remarkable results to address Large Language Models’ hallucinations, which usually uses a large external corpus to supplement knowledge to LLMs. However, with the development of LLMs, the internal knowledge of LLMs has expanded significantly, thus causing significant knowledge redundancy between the external corpus and LLMs.

arxiv-2511-03193.title: Statistical Properties of Rectified Flow
arxiv-2511-03193.creator: Gonzalo Mena, Arun Kumar Kuchibhotla, Larry Wasserman
arxiv-2511-03193.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gonzalo Mena, Arun Kumar Kuchibhotla, Larry Wasserman. Rectified flow ( 71 ; 70 ; 99 ) is a method for defining a transport map between two distributions, and enjoys popularity in machine learning, although theoretical results supporting the validity of these methods are scant.

openalex-w7205014679.title: A LUDICIDADE NO PROCESSO DE ALFABETIZAÇÃO: ESTRATÉGIAS E POSSIBILIDADES NOS ANOS INICIAIS
openalex-w7205014679.creator: Joseli Aurélio dos Santos Lima
openalex-w7205014679.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7205014679.description: A alfabetização constitui uma etapa fundamental da educação básica, sendo responsável pelo desenvolvimento de conhecimentos essenciais relacionados à leitura, à escrita e à participação social. Nesse contexto, as estratégias lúdicas apresentam-se como recursos pedagógicos...

pmc-10483873.title: Social vulnerability, impacts and adaptations strategies in the face of natural hazards: insight from riverine islands of Bangladesh
pmc-10483873.creator: Babul Hossain, Guoqing Shi, Chen Ajiang, Md Salman Sohel, Liu Yijun
pmc-10483873.description: BackgroundBangladesh is one of the countries at risk of natural disasters due to climate change. In particular, inhabitants of its riverine islands (char) confront ongoing climatic events that heighten their vulnerability. This study aims to assess social vulnerability, impacts, and adaptation strategies to climate change in the riverine island areas of Bangladesh.

pmc-10570692.title: The post-award effort of managing and reporting on funded research: a scoping review
pmc-10570692.creator: Ksenia Crane, Amanda Blatch-Jones, Kathryn Fackrell, Simon Kerridge, Simon Kerridge, Caitlin Brandenburg
pmc-10570692.description: Introduction: Reporting is a mechanism for funding organisations to monitor and manage the progress, outputs, outcomes, and impacts of the research they fund. Inconsistent approaches to reporting and post-award management, and a growing demand for research information, can lead to perception of unnecessary administrative effort that impacts on decision-making and research activity.

pmc-10662584.title: Artificial Intelligence–Driven Single-Shot PET Image Artifact Detection and Disentanglement
pmc-10662584.creator: Isaac Shiri, Yazdan Salimi, Elsa Hervier, Agathe Pezzoni, Amirhossein Sanaat, Shayan Mostafaei, Arman Rahmim, Ismini Mainta, Habib Zaidi
pmc-10662584.description: PurposeMedical imaging artifacts compromise image quality and quantitative analysis and might confound interpretation and misguide clinical decision-making. The present work envisions and demonstrates a new paradigm PET image Quality Assurance NETwork (PET-QA-NET) in which various image artifacts are detected and disentangled from images without prior knowledge of a standard of reference or ground truth for routine PET image quality assurance.

pmc-10664072.title: A Dibenzotetrathiafulvalene-Bridged Bis(alkenylruthenium) Complex and Its One- and Two-Electron-Oxidized Forms
pmc-10664072.creator: Franciska
pmc-10664072.description: We report on the synthesis of the new bis(alkenylruthenium) complex DBTTF-(ViRu)2 with a longitudinally extended, π-conjugated dibenzotetrathiafulvalene (DBTTF) bridge, characterized by multinuclear NMR, IR, and UV/vis spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction. Cyclic and square-wave voltammetry revealed that DBTTF-(ViRu)2 undergoes four consecutive oxidations.

pmc-10743850.title: Frailty in Older Patients with Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis
pmc-10743850.creator: Stéphanie Cazalbou, Louise Naccache, Sandrine Sourdet, Eve Cariou, Pauline Fournier, Fati Nourhashemi, Laurent Balardy, Olivier Toulza, Olivier Lairez, Zara Steinmeyer, on behalf of the Toulouse Amyloidosis Research Network
pmc-10743850.description: Background—Transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CA) prevalence increases with age. The interplay between frailty and heart failure has been increasingly recognized. The objective of this study is to compare clinical, biological, and transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) characteristics of older ATTR-CA patients according to the G8 frailty screening tool.

pmc-11440262.title: ACL injury characteristics in badminton : A registry study with prospectively collected data on sports related epidemiology and injury mechanism of 539 badminton players
pmc-11440262.creator: Niels Christian Kaldau, Frederik Flensted Andersen, Kristoffer Weisskirchner Barfod, Peter Nyby Hersnaes, Jesper Bencke, Per Hölmich
pmc-11440262.description: BackgroundOver recent years, more anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) ruptures in badminton players have occurred. Little is known about the injury mechanism in badminton. The hypothesis is that most ACL injuries occur with single leg landings on the non-dominant leg in the backhand side or with lunge movements in the forehand side on the dominant leg.

pmc-11515942.title: Empathy, Moral Sensitivity, and Prosocial Behavior Among Medical Undergraduates in a South Indian Tertiary Care Teaching Institute: An Analytical Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11515942.creator: Sagnika Chowdhury, Naveen K G, Robin T Vavachan
pmc-11515942.description: Introduction: Empathy, moral sensitivity, and prosocialness are critical traits for medical professionals, as they affect patient care quality and ethical decision-making. These traits help address psychological complexities like stress and burnout in medical practice. Despite their importance, the relationships between these traits, especially among medical students, remain underexplored.

pmc-12436400.title: The clinical application potential assessment of the Deepseek-R1 large language model in lung cancer
pmc-12436400.creator: Xiaowan Xu, Zhibo Liu, Shihao Zhou, Baoyan Ji, Deyan Fan, Zijuan Yang, Hongli Chen, Xiuli Yang, Mengru Guan
pmc-12436400.description: BackgroundThis study evaluates the clinical potential of the large language model Deepseek-R1 in the diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer, with a specific focus on its ability to assist junior oncologists. The research systematically assesses the model’s performance in terms of diagnostic accuracy, consistency of treatment recommendations, and reliability in clinical decision-making.

pmc-12613779.title: When time turns the tide: the interactive effects of ammonium and warming during the larval stage on the resulting adult frogs
pmc-12613779.creator: Francisco Javier Zamora-Camacho, Pedro Aragón
pmc-12613779.description: BackgroundTwo central elements of the global change are a rise in average temperatures and the contamination of natural habitats, among others, with agricultural fertilizers, which can stress living beings. Avoidance of these stressors is often impossible for animals confined in certain habitats, such as pond-dwelling tadpoles, which can indeed select less stressful microhabitats after metamorphosis.

pmc-12654240.title: Integrating Advanced Metabolomics and Machine Learning for Anti-Doping in Human Athletes
pmc-12654240.creator: Mohannad N AbuHaweeleh, Ahmad Hamdan, Jawaher Al-Essa, Shaikha Aljaal, Nasser Al Saad, Costas Georgakopoulos, Francesco Botre, Mohamed A Elrayess, Teruo Miyazaki
pmc-12654240.description: The ongoing challenge of doping in sports has triggered the adoption of advanced scientific strategies for the detection and prevention of doping abuse. This review examines the potential of integrating metabolomics aided by artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) for profiling small-molecule metabolites across biological systems to advance anti-doping efforts.

pmc-13014096.title: Time of day of CAR T-cell infusion and outcomes in large B-cell lymphoma∗
pmc-13014096.creator: Danny Luan, Ori Ben Valid, Ofrat Beyar-Katz, Tobias Tix, Noa Golan Accav, Mohammad Alhomoud, Abraham Avigdor, Veit L Bücklein, Limor Cohen, Parastoo B Dahi, Sigrun Einarsdottir, Julia Elimelech, Silvia Escribano-Serrat, Lorenzo Falchi, Teng Fei, Sergio Giralt, Marina Gomez-Llobell, Andre Goy, Nurit
pmc-13014096.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Key Points•Earlier infusion time of CAR T-cell therapy was independently associated with improved PFS in large B-cell lymphoma.•These findings support the prospective evaluation of circadian-informed CAR T-cell delivery. Introduction

Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has transformed care for relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL), yet outcomes and toxicities remain heterogeneous, motivating the search for factors that influence efficacy and safety.

pmc-13605526.title: Antioxidant Capacity and Phenolic Profile of Edible Carob Pods (Ceratonia siliqua L.)
pmc-13605526.creator: Stamatia Angeliki Kleftaki, Thalia Tsiaka, Georgios Bekiaris, Eleni Papapanagi, Charalampia Amerikanou, Sotirios-Spyridon Vamvakas, Aristea Gioxari, Panagiotis Zoumpoulakis, Andriana C. Kaliora
pmc-13605526.description: Our study aimed, for the first time, to comparatively characterize edible carob powder from the Imera and Platses cultivars in terms of phenolic composition and antioxidant capacity, providing the first comprehensive characterization of the underexplored Platses cultivar using an integrated multi-analytical approach.
